Opening a Corporate Bank Account in the UAE

Written by Al Anfal Doc Team·Last updated 18 August 2026

What banks look for and how to prepare a strong application.

Quick answer

Banks decide on corporate account applications using their own compliance rules, so a clear and complete file matters. Typically a bank asks for the trade licence, memorandum of association, shareholder and manager IDs, proof of address and a short business profile.

Key takeaways

  • Banks apply their own compliance rules
  • A complete file with a clear business profile helps
  • Requirements differ by bank

At a glance

At a glance
Usually requiredTrade licence and memorandum of association
Also requiredShareholder and manager IDs
Also requiredProof of address
Also requiredA short business profile
